summary: Frontend E2E testing of Activos + QR modules integrated in Overall Tracking. Verified auto-login on /assets (no infinite spinner), CRUD, filters, QR image loads (data:image/png;base64), edit flow, public QR page, public report flow producing SOL-###### with tracking navigation, and sidebar routes (nueva-solicitud, mis-solicitudes) still functional. All critical flows PASS.

issues: shadcn DialogContent missing aria-describedby/DialogDescription -> a11y warning in console (non-blocking)

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to DialogContent in AssetFormDialog and the QR label dialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js: ensureSession() memoizes the promise for the lifetime of the tab. If the auto-login fails once (network hiccup), further navigations won't retry until reload. Consider resetting _sessionPromise on failure.
Assets.js: search input triggers a request on every keystroke (no debounce). Fine for small lists but should be debounced for scalability.
AssetDetail.js: qr.image is loaded once with no retry/error state; if /assets/{id}/qr fails silently the panel shows the spinner forever.

Auth is now Bearer token in localStorage while backend also supports httpOnly cookies. Storing JWTs in localStorage is XSS-exposed; document the trade-off. Also api.js still sets withCredentials:true which is unnecessary now.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 asset via UI (TEST-<timestamp>) and 1 public report SOL-000012 during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright flow verified end-to-end. Key data-testids: assets-page, asset-card-{CODE}, asset-search-input, asset-filter-status/category, create-asset-button, asset-code/name/category/location-input, asset-status-select, asset-save-button, asset-form-error, asset-detail-page, asset-qr-image, qr-view/download/print-button, edit-asset-button, public-asset-page, report-problem-button, locked-asset, report-name/email/description-input, submit-report-button, report-success, result-number, view-tracking-button. qr_token is exposed in the DOM as text under the QR image (format .../a/{token}). Auto-login writes JWT to localStorage['ot_token'].
